t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Neen dibainidaum O neend Gitche Manitou, tchi keen ge gezhetod neend tchiway kikaindijaay keen gahyay tchiway tchiway unimayntahwah keen, Neen megiway gebauwindamowin, tchiway neen tchibahdan ningupassangwaubiwin, tchiway neen kawween gashkiywaysiwiin gahyay tchiway ke nawindamowin ningapassangwaubiwin, tchiway neend kitimaagin kahyen tchiway ke daununwin. Eeamahgay kauwensah bahkaun Gitche Manitou, auhinbaayshaydaan, wedokaugaukegaan ween tebinawaawin gashkaun Gitche Manitou, tchi keen gahyay tchiway ke daununwin. Eemahgay kauwensah bahkaun Gitche Manitou, auhinbaayshaydaan, wedokaugaukegaan ween tebinawaawin gashkaun, tebinawaawin gashkaun Gitche Manitou, tchi keen gehzhetod neend tchiway ke daununwin. Eeahgay kauwensah bebinaayshee gaakosheetums oopen es olkosheetwhu lu es yapastenee. Lu ta epl chinaks Kolinstuten, e.chimish Anawee.
